anchors.decision: Preserve Mark’s immediately/at-once urgency selectively where it structures scenes; do not mechanically reproduce every conjunction.
Use good news for euangelion and keep the proclamation network visible from 1:1 through 16.
Use kingdom of God as the main familiar biblical rendering for basileia, with reign/rule preserved in apparatus.
Preserve paradidōmi as hand over across John, Judas, Jesus’ predictions, arrest, trial, and discipleship warnings.
Preserve exousia/authority from teaching and exorcism through the Jerusalem authority dispute.
Preserve follow/come after and hodos/way so the journey to Jerusalem and discipleship remain lexically connected.
Retain Son of Man without paraphrasing the title into one interpretation.
Preserve the sōzō network while allowing contextually natural save/heal/restore/made-well renderings.
Preserve clean/unclean and defilement language as a major purity/restoration network.
Preserve seeing/hearing/understanding/hardened-heart language, especially across bread, blindness, confession, and discipleship.
Preserve commands to silence, failed silence, and gradual disclosure without turning them into a single explanatory theory.
Preserve cross-bearing, cup, hand-over, mock kingship, saving irony, and abandonment language without doctrinal expansion.
Treat 16:1–8 as SBLGNT continuous main text and 16:9–20 as clearly separated ancient textual tradition; note the shorter ending in apparatus.
